claim_under_test: Three cost-inefficient behaviours affect 79-98% of coding tasks and up to 22.75% of task cost, and developer-designed skills reduce cost by up to 41.73%, roughly twice the maximum gain from agent-synthesised skills.
data_fingerprint: published tables in the arXiv HTML full text, transcribed into the script with table references in comments
harness_commit: not-applicable: no harness was modified. This run is a CPU-only re-derivation of the paper's published arithmetic, so there is no train.py patch and no diff.patch. The script identity is the sha256 in script_sha256, which was re-confirmed on the push heartbeat.
cost_note: No RunPod pod created. Zero dollars against the $3.25 board budget.
seed_note: no seeds: the estimand is a set of deterministic identities, so replication cannot move it

push_history.detail: The originating run could not push. Paperclip GitHub capability returned 'capability_rejected' for every gh/git write; anonymous git ls-remote still worked. Recorded as an unfiled draft at the time.

The retry heartbeat re-read the capability rather than trusting the prior conclusion, per operating constraint 10.3. POST /runtime-tools/github/credentials returned status 'available' and the connector resolved to identity dustin-dev-35. Repository dustin-dev-35/axv was re-read and exists, public, default branch main. The two AXV-6 commits that were stranded unpushed were pushed first, then this run directory, the superseding memo and the leaderboard record.

pushed_commit: recorded in the commit that adds experiments/runs/axv-2609.30725-accounting-01/; see git log -- experiments/runs/axv-2609.30725-accounting-01

correction_history.outcome: record-found-clean; the defect was in the leaderboard row, not in this directory
correction_history.detail: The reported warning text did not originate in this run directory. run.json, metrics.json and axv_recheck_2609_30725.py all carry the correct figures (110.80, 34.1x, 3.25, five tasks), and the script asserts the last two as verified checks at lines 225 and 226. The only bad copy was the hand-transcribed fourth warning of lb-axv-2609.30725-accounting-01, corrected by the append-only record lb-axv-2609.30725-accounting-01-r2. This run directory has no warnings array of its own, which is why the figure could drift without any local contradiction to catch it.
correction_history.root_cause: Not a stale budget. The warning string was written in a PowerShell double-quoted string, and PowerShell interpolated each $ as a variable name, so 0.554 printed as .554, 110.80 as .80, and 3.25 as .25. Reproduced exactly in the correcting heartbeat before the record was written. The 34.1x multiple and the five-task count were never wrong; only the three operand figures were destroyed by the shell.
correction_history.requested_fix_rejected: AXV-40 asked for 24.6% of budget and about six tasks. Both are wrong: 24.6% is 0.80/3.25 and 0.80 is not a figure in this run, and int(3.25/0.554) = 5 because six tasks cost 3.32 against a 3.25 budget. Not applied.

reproduced_on_push_heartbeat.note: Independent re-execution of the script from a clean copy, on Python 3.12.10. Identical output. The estimand is deterministic arithmetic, so a second execution confirms the transcription, not a stochastic effect.
